description: Erection of single storey outbuilding in place of the existing garage.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (568.L.01, 568.03, 568.01: Received 20/07/2020. 568.L.01a: Received 25/08/2020.568.02b: Received 27/08/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the outbuilding hereby permitted shall match those used in the main house.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the dwellings at 125 Woodland Gardens Road, TW7 6LU, and not as primary residential accommodation or for business purposes, nor shall any bathroom or kitchen facilities be installed into the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
